title: Entropic unpaired transport and barycentric alignment
formal_object: Training distributions a,b of positive masses, cost C, entropic OT pi with exact marginals; target y_i=sum_j pi_ij c_j/a_i.
assumptions: Transport uses train-only features; release labels are not intentionally discarded to create an artificial unpaired problem.
Regularized OT is strictly convex for positive compatible masses, but semantic correspondences may be unidentifiable.
A geometric cost needs actual cross-modal comparability and stable class proportions.

operations.condition: Positive masses with equal total and eps>0

operations.output: Transport fit alone cannot identify semantic class correspondences.

derivation_steps.statement: C_ij+eps log pi_ij+alpha_i+beta_j=0 gives Gibbs factors; row/column sums determine u,v.
derivation_steps.justification: Differentiate the entropy objective and include both marginal multipliers.

derivation_steps.statement: y_i=sum_j pi_ij c_j/a_i, W=(Q^T Q+rho I)^-1Q^T Y for ridge rho>0.
derivation_steps.justification: The row marginal a_i normalizes the conditional barycenter; normal equations produce a finite train-only alignment.

derivation_steps.statement: If equal-mass semantic clusters and their geometry admit a permutation, unpaired observations/cost can remain invariant under relabeling.
derivation_steps.justification: This constructs an identifiability boundary; optimization correctness cannot repair missing semantic information.

method_expression: Fit a train-only entropic coupling with marginal residuals, form barycenters and solve the explicit ridge alignment; declare it a conditional unpaired alignment construction until a genuine unpaired native problem is established.
distinguishing_prediction: Benefits require independently justified geometric identifiability; class proportion or symmetry shifts should expose failures before any claim of general semantic alignment.
falsifier: Paired Procrustes or simpler nearest-neighbor alignment uses legal available information and matches the result; semantic permutations make correspondence ambiguous.
closest_alternative: Entropic OT/Sinkhorn, barycentric mapping and ridge/Procrustes alignment; no new transport mechanism is established.
decisive_comparison: Only a genuinely unpaired authorized task can test this; equal legal information and complete native output/control costs must be fixed before dispatch.
legacy_code_audit: Parked historically: no I15 implementation, no qualified unpaired task. Retain parked status rather than removing paired labels.
review_limit: Conditional construction reviewed; actual task need, source collision audit and scientific premise pending.
